Original OPC/XML probes generated by tools/section_before_spacing_fixture.py, exported with the reference application. All 72 pages have retained PDF baseline coordinates and package/PDF SHA-256 hashes. Variants cover omitted compatibility settings, mode 14, mode 15, and mode 15 with suppressSpBfAfterPgBrk. Section before-gaps subtract the previous paragraph after-gap, clamped at zero, including empty section-ending paragraphs. Page-break-before paragraphs use the same subtraction in legacy modes and suppress the gap in mode 15. Paragraphs following a terminal run-level page break suppress before-spacing in all tested variants. First-page spacing is retained. No third-party template content.
